title: Adeega aan idiin hayno
text:
Waxaan idiin haynaa adeegyo ay ka mid yihiin:
1. Ultrasound kambiyuutar
2. Laboratory shaybaad
3. Talobixin

Xanuunada aanu dawayno waxa ka mid ah xanuun kasta oo ku dhaca dumarka iyo hooyooyinka uurka leh.

title: New Clinic Location
text: We are now opposite Ayuub Restaurant, near Masjid Nuur, with more space and modern equipment for our patients.

title: Updated Working Hours
text: We are open from 4:00 PM to 9:00 PM daily, so working women can book after their workday.
